title: Running: a live summary of every running project above Needs you in the sidebar

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner 2026-10-25. Each project's own page shows what it runs at the top (status, stage bar, animation, sparkline), and a top-level entry above Needs you in the sidebar, Running, shows every project with a live run, always current: project, item, the pipeline with the running role, stage bar, round, last heard, sparkline and any question or stop that needs the owner. Enter drops into that run's pane (which follows the newest running run, see the run-pane-follow slice). 1 s refresh while visible. Builds on S97 (pipeline, last heard), S07 (stage bar, ticker, sparkline) and the run-pane-follow slice.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/view.go:175-230` (sidebar) and `internal/tui/model.go:728-744` (`navigation()`: a new sentinel for Running above the Needs you sentinel -1).
- `internal/tui/overview.go:374` (the aggregate Running section): reused full-screen as the Running view, with question and stop alerts added; `internal/tui/relayboard.go` for the board parts.
- `internal/cache/cache.go:160-167`: the 1 s Runs interval (S109) for every project with a live run while the entry or a pane is visible; `cache.Limit` is 4 concurrent CLI processes (:28).
- Tests beside each; goldens `testdata/golden/running-*.txt`; `docs/dashboard.md`, `docs/design.md`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestSidebarHasARunningEntryAboveNeedsYouAndHidesItWhenNothingRuns (or shows a dim "nothing running").
- TestSummaryListsEveryProjectWithALiveRun with the pipeline, bar, round, last heard and sparkline per row.
- TestSummaryRowsUpdateOnTheNextRefresh and a project whose run ends drops to Recent without a keypress.
- TestQuestionOrStopShowsAnAlertOnTheSummaryRowAndEnterOpensItsPane.
- TestSummaryAtEightyByTwentyFour keeps the stage bar and role.
- Golden views, colour and monochrome.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first (injected clock). 2. The sidebar entry and the summary view. 3. The all-projects live refresh. 4. Alerts for questions and stops. 5. Docs and goldens. UI slice: UI pass (r14). Open for the preflight: the key for the entry (0 is Needs you in S85), the empty state, and the refresh cost with 14 projects.

Owner decisions (2026-10-25 batch spec check): adj 169 ui.sidebar-running, option reuse-overview (open until the owner decides it; revises #82's sidebar order). No new summary.go: the Running entry opens the aggregate Overview's Running section full-screen plus alerts. Reached with up/down and enter; no digit until S85 and S105 settle keys (keys.go Jump is 1-9 only). Always shown, dim "nothing running" when empty, so rows do not shift. Fact fixes: project pages show Needs you before Running today (overview.go:374, docs/dashboard.md:180-187); S106 (v1.1) moves Running up. "The run-pane-follow slice" is S109 and "the run-card-first slice" is S106. Depends on S109.
